def process(constitutionBeach, carsonBeach, mStreetBeach, wollastonBeach, pleasureBayCastleIsland, malibuBeach, teneanBeach, cityPointBeach) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    def tidy_one(df: pd.DataFrame, beach_name: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        d = df.copy()

        # Identify the header row: first row where first column equals 'Date' (case-insensitive)
        first_col = d.columns[0]
        col0 = d[first_col].astype(str).str.strip()
        if not col0.str.lower().eq('date').any():
            return pd.DataFrame(columns=['beach', 'date', 'rain3', 'enterococcus'])
        header_idx = col0.str.lower().eq('date').idxmax()

        header = d.loc[header_idx].tolist()
        d2 = d.loc[header_idx + 1 :].copy()
        d2.columns = [str(x).strip() for x in header]

        # Ensure rainfall columns exist (case-insensitive match)
        colmap = {c.lower().strip(): c for c in d2.columns}
        needed = ['date', '3-day rain']
        if any(k not in colmap for k in needed):
            return pd.DataFrame(columns=['beach', 'date', 'rain3', 'enterococcus'])

        date_col = colmap['date']
        rain3_col = colmap['3-day rain']

        # Find all enterococcus columns (may be repeated)
        ent_cols = [c for c in d2.columns if str(c).strip().lower() == 'enterococcus']
        if not ent_cols:
            return pd.DataFrame(columns=['beach', 'date', 'rain3', 'enterococcus'])

        def parse_ent(col) -> pd.Series:
            # col can be a Series or a 1-col DataFrame
            if isinstance(col, pd.DataFrame):
                col = col.iloc[:, 0]
            s = col.astype(str).str.strip()
            s = s.replace({'nan': np.nan, '': np.nan, 'none': np.nan, 'None': np.nan})
            s = s.str.replace(r'^[<>]\s*', '', regex=True)
            return pd.to_numeric(s, errors='coerce')

        ent_vals = pd.concat([parse_ent(d2[[c]]) for c in ent_cols], axis=1)

        out = pd.DataFrame({
            'beach': beach_name,
            'date': pd.to_datetime(d2[date_col], errors='coerce'),
            'rain3': pd.to_numeric(d2[rain3_col], errors='coerce'),
        })

        long = out.loc[out['date'].notna()].join(ent_vals)
        long = long.melt(id_vars=['beach', 'date', 'rain3'], value_name='enterococcus')
        long = long.drop(columns=['variable']).dropna(subset=['enterococcus', 'rain3'])
        return long

    frames = [
        tidy_one(constitutionBeach, 'Constitution Beach'),
        tidy_one(carsonBeach, 'Carson Beach'),
        tidy_one(mStreetBeach, 'M Street Beach'),
        tidy_one(wollastonBeach, 'Wollaston Beach'),
        tidy_one(pleasureBayCastleIsland, 'Pleasure Bay / Castle Island'),
        tidy_one(malibuBeach, 'Malibu Beach'),
        tidy_one(teneanBeach, 'Tenean Beach'),
        tidy_one(cityPointBeach, 'City Point Beach'),
    ]

    all_long = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)

    # No rainfall in preceding three days => 3-Day Rain == 0
    no_rain = all_long[all_long['rain3'].fillna(np.inf).eq(0)]

    # Failed swimming standard if Enterococcus >= 104
    no_rain = no_rain.copy()
    no_rain['failed'] = no_rain['enterococcus'] >= 104

    counts = (
        no_rain[no_rain['failed']]
        .groupby('beach')
        .size()
        .reset_index(name='failed_samples_no_rain')
        .sort_values(['failed_samples_no_rain', 'beach'], ascending=[False, True])
    )

    return counts

operators.customDisplayName: For each beach datasheet table [constitution, carson, m_street, wollaston, pleasure_bay_and_castle_island, malibu, tenean, city_point]: detect the real header row where first column equals 'Date' (case-insensitive); reassign columns; extract Date and 3-Day Rain plus all columns named 'Enterococcus' (to handle multi-station sheets); robustly parse Enterococcus numeric values even when the selection returns a 1-col DataFrame (strip leading '<' or '>'); reshape to long format (one row per date per enterococcus measurement); filter to samples with 3-Day Rain == 0; count samples failing swimming standard (Enterococcus >= 104 counts/100mL) per beach; return beaches sorted by failed_samples_no_rain desc (then beach asc).
